## RESEARCH VERDICT

Verdict: caution  
Risk: medium  
Confidence: 0.68  
Rationale: Screen buy rests on yield/cheapness, but FY2025 Yahoo OCF−CapEx FCF is −$782m while filings pay 80% NPAT dividends; H1 2026 company FCF $352m vs $1,084m interim payout leaves FCF-cover tension open.  
RiskTags: cyclical, leverage

## COMPARISON EVIDENCE

### EVIDENCE

- [filings/bodies/9fbf9aecbbc93b03.txt] "Delivered operating cash flow of $3,013 million and free cash flow of $352 million." — H1 2026 cash generation vs dividend capacity
- [filings/bodies/9fbf9aecbbc93b03.txt] "The total amount of the interim dividend payment is $1,084 million which represents 80% of underlying NPAT" — High payout despite modest company FCF in the half
- [filings/bodies/9fbf9aecbbc93b03.txt] "Gearing of 20.6%, marginally outside the target range of 10 - 20%" — Balance-sheet strain during the capex cycle
- [filings/bodies/c0645bc990f11c2d.txt] "we generated free cash flow of $1.9 billion." — Company-adjusted FY2025 FCF (differs from screen GAAP bridge)
- [filings/bodies/c0645bc990f11c2d.txt] "total fully franked full-year dividend to 112 US cents per share. This represents a payout ratio of 80% of underlying NPAT" — Dividend-family screen support from filings
- [filings/bodies/f51572b9e57dde7a.txt] "Woodside had liquidity of approximately $9,300 million and net debt (including lease liabilities) of approximately $8,000 million." — Liquidity offsets near-term FCF shortfall
- [filings/bodies/cd966ff6b2c32090.txt] "Free cash flow achieved a year-on-year increase of more than 150%" — H1 2026 improvement but still modest in absolute terms

### THESIS BREAKS

- Board cuts dividends below the stated 50–80% underlying NPAT policy without a matching commodity-price shock disclosed in filings.
- Gearing stays above the 10–20% target through FY2027 as Louisiana LNG capex ramps without offsetting partner cash or asset sales.
- FY2026–FY2027 statutory operating cash flow minus capital expenditure stays negative while payouts remain at ~80% of underlying NPAT.
- Material impairment or cost overrun on Scarborough, Trion, or Louisiana LNG disclosed in a subsequent interim or annual report.
